title: Interest Rate Buydown Documentation Standards: Agreements, Addenda and Payment-Change Notices
content:
**Interest Rate Buydown — documentation by product.** Each product of the Interest Rate Buydown carries its own requirements for a purchase contract addendum, a buydown agreement and the notices that tell the borrower how the payment will change.

| Product | Seller or builder funded buydown needs a purchase contract addendum | Borrower signs a buydown agreement | Who must sign the buydown agreement | Borrower receives a payment schedule showing every step-up | Days before each yearly step-up that the borrower is notified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | Yes | Yes | the borrower and the payer | Yes | 45 |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | Yes | Yes | the borrower and the payer | Yes | 45 |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | Yes | Yes | the borrower and the payer | Yes | 45 |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | Yes | Yes | the borrower and the payer | Yes | 45 |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | Yes | No | the borrower | No | 0 |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | Yes | No | the borrower | No | 0 |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | Yes | No | the borrower | No | 0 |

**Addendum.** For every product, a buydown paid by a seller or a builder needs a purchase contract addendum.

**Buydown agreement.** On the four temporary products the borrower signs a buydown agreement, and the signers are the borrower and the payer. On the three permanent products the requirement shows No, and the signer shown is the borrower.

**Payment schedule and notices.** On the four temporary products the borrower receives a payment schedule showing every step-up, and is notified 45 days before each yearly step-up. On the three permanent products no payment schedule is shown as required and the notice period is 0 days.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

| Hypothetical buydown | Purchase contract addendum | Buydown agreement and its signers |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown paid by the builder | needed | signed by the borrower and the builder |
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown paid by the seller | needed | signed by the borrower and the seller |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown paid by the seller | needed | requirement shows No; signer shown is the borrower |

On a hypothetical Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown, every yearly step-up of the payment rate is preceded by a notice to the borrower 45 days before that step-up; on a hypothetical Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown the notice period is 0 days.
